errors.evidence: The categories are arranged from top to bottom in ascending order of their percentage values (from 2.7% to 48.6%), not in descending order as stated.

The description only provides the highest (48.6%) and lowest (2.7%) values. It omits all intermediate values and fails to mention the salient feature that two categories, "Екологични рискове" (Environmental risks) and "Риск от непредвидени обстоятелства" (Risk of unforeseen circumstances), share the same value of 5.4%.
